newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ralcorp buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ralcorp buy repeated.

text.p: Sanford Bernstein analyst Steven Galbraith said Thursday he reiterated his buy rating on food company Ralcorp Holdings Inc.
-- Galbraith said the company's chairman, William Stiritz, recently bought shares in the company, which is seen as positive.
-- Ralcorp confirmed the chairman purchased 385,000 shares recently.
-- "He (Stiritz) is buying and he's been a really savvy investor," Galbraith said.
-- The analyst added that the stock is cheap compared with its revenues, adding that he considered Ralcorp "a classic value story."
